items.html: And behold, the secret of Atik of Beriah is the secret of the point of Malchut of Atzilut, to whom the Holy One, blessed be He, said: 'Go and diminish yourself, and you shall be a head for foxes.' For this is a head for all of Beriah. And then she is the secret of Atik of Beriah, and is clothed in the three highest of the VAK of AA, which are the revealed HGT, as stated above. And afterward we shall explain, with God's help, the aforementioned point of Malchut of Atzilut.
